5048.body: Two games can cost the same, promise the same top prize, and still be totally different animals. "FLORIDA 300X THE CASH" is a grinder — it pays out lots of smaller prizes instead of a few monsters — about three-quarters of its unclaimed prize money sits in wins under $5,000, with the rest stacked up top. Neither style is "better." They're just built for different players. Late-run games aren't automatically good or bad — the same numbers just mean different things near the end of a run.
